questions.prompt: What do penguins use their wings for?
choices: Their strong wings sweep them through water.
Their strong wings lift them above mountains.
Their strong wings dig deep tree holes.
questions.answer: Their strong wings sweep them through water.
questions.evidenceText: Penguins cannot fly, but their strong wings sweep them through water.

questions.prompt: Which sentence tells about the fathers huddle in Emperor Penguins and Their Relatives?
choices: The fathers huddle close for warmth while the mothers hunt at sea.
Penguins cannot fly, but their strong wings sweep them through water.
Not every penguin lives on ice. Some make their homes on warmer coasts.
questions.answer: The fathers huddle close for warmth while the mothers hunt at sea.
questions.evidenceText: The fathers huddle close for warmth while the mothers hunt at sea.

questions.prompt: What is the big idea of Emperor Penguins and Their Relatives?
choices: Penguins have traits that help them live in different places.
Only penguins cannot fly, but their strong wings sweep them through water.
Only the fathers huddle close for warmth while the mothers hunt at sea.
questions.answer: Penguins have traits that help them live in different places.
questions.rationale: Penguins cannot fly, but their strong wings sweep them through water. The fathers huddle close for warmth while the mothers hunt at sea. Not every penguin lives on ice. Some make their homes on warmer coasts. Together, these facts show the whole-book big idea: Penguins have traits that help them live in different places.
